crossRefs.note: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;
Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power…
We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
Your way was through the sea; your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.
Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out…
Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint.…
All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know…
Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his…
But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.
“For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.
To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

translations.web: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
translations.bsb: Can you fathom the deep things of God or discover the limits of the Almighty?
translations.kjv: Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?
translations.asv: Canst thou by searching find out God? Canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?
